comparison.objective: Rotate manifold fittings to establish a coolant route, versus tune and lock a physical damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Contact-driven revolute fitting manipulation plus route planning versus tool insertion, fastener loosening/tightening, fine collar control, and dynamic-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Angle-derived logical connectivity to the outlet versus physically simulated stopping performance over two cycles with safety and lock-retention constraints.
comparison.reason: This record tests configuration planning; coolant physics are explicitly not simulated. It does not test force-limited locking or impact-response commissioning. No spec versions are present, and the body omits detailed angle tolerances.
